targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS current_picks FROM editors_choice
SELECT count(*) AS upcoming_picks FROM editors_choice ec JOIN events e ON e.id = ec.event_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(*) AS past_picks FROM editors_choice ec JOIN events e ON e.id = ec.event_id WHERE e.datum < CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(selected_by, 'unknown')) AS editors FROM editors_choice
SELECT date_trunc('day', selected_at) AS time, 'picks' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM editors_choice WHERE selected_at >= now() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COALESCE(selected_by, 'unknown') AS selected_by, count(*) AS picks FROM editors_choice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY picks DESC

SELECT COALESCE(l.district, 'unknown') AS district, count(*) AS picks FROM editors_choice ec JOIN events e ON e.id = ec.event_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY picks DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(e.category), ''), 'uncategorized') AS category, count(*) AS picks FROM editors_choice ec JOIN events e ON e.id = ec.event_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY picks DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT e.datum, count(*) AS picks FROM editors_choice ec JOIN events e ON e.id = ec.event_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY e.datum ORDER BY e.datum LIMIT 20

SELECT ec.selected_at, ec.selected_by, e.datum, e.von, e.thema AS title, l.name AS location, COALESCE(l.district, '') AS district, ec.note FROM editors_choice ec JOIN events e ON e.id = ec.event_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id ORDER BY e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE DESC, e.datum, e.von LIMIT 60

SELECT e.datum, count(*) AS events, count(ec.event_id) AS picked_events, round(100.0 * count(ec.event_id) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS pick_coverage_percent FROM events e LEFT JOIN editors_choice ec ON ec.event_id = e.id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE AND e.datum < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY e.datum ORDER BY e.datum LIMIT 30
